task: Clean SophisticatedDocumentViewer toolbar in Archive and Plagiarism Checker and enable in-document highlighting on original DOCX and PDF documents

changes.summary: Suppressed logo, chapter title, and version badge when viewing documents in archive or plagiarism checker; suppressed Revision Diff (+/-) unless tracking active submissions with revision history; suppressed All Layers and Comments unless submission review is active; fixed fullscreen layout so viewerContent and header do not vertically shift offscreen; added in-document DOM scanning and mark injection in DocxPreviewRenderer with Turnitin-style highlights.

Updated resolvePlagiarismHighlights to unwind candidateSpans from all match shapes (flat highlight objects, matchedBlocks arrays, and root suspectText) with sentence-level splitting fallback for robust grounding.
Passed isPlagiarismReport={true}, hideIdentity={true}, showRevisionDiff={false}, and showComments={false} to embedded and modal SophisticatedDocumentViewer instances, with active highlight tracking.

prevention_rule: Rule 53: When viewing documents in Archive or Plagiarism Checker, suppress revision diff, faculty comments, chapter titles, and logo icon boxes. Preserve Turnitin-style in-document highlighting across both PDF text layers and docx-preview OOXML rendered DOM. In fullscreen mode, ensure the modal dialog does not use flex vertical centering on tall document content that would push the header offscreen.
